FAST helps you remain fair and aligned with your values.

## Fair {#fair}

Be fair to yourself and to the other person. Include both sets of needs and facts.

## No Unnecessary Apologies {#no-unnecessary-apologies}

Do not over-apologize for having an opinion, making a request, disagreeing, or saying no. Apologize when an apology fits the facts, not for existing or having needs.

## Stick to Values {#stick-to-values}

Act in line with your values. Do not abandon what matters merely to gain approval or avoid conflict. Be clear about which value is at stake.

## Truthful {#truthful}

Do not lie, exaggerate, make excuses, or act helpless when you are not. Describe your reasons accurately and avoid manipulating the situation.

#### Text Version

Think of a situation you are currently experiencing or have experienced recently where the SELF-RESPECT in the situation was/is the priority. Use the DEAR FAST script below to practice how this skill could be used.

##### SELF-RESPECT issue (How I want to feel about myself?)

Describe situation.

##### E

xpress feelings/opinions. Assert request (or say no) directly (circle the part you will use later in "broken record" to stay Mindful if you need it). Reinforcing comments to make. Be Eair and no Apologies. Comments to make (if needed). Stick to your values and be Iruthful. Comments to make (if needed)
